_comment: Chessboard zone geometry (item 1, LOCKED S32; docs/chessboard_design.md). 6 bands x 5 lanes = 30 zones on the StatsBomb 120x80 pitch, in ATTACK-orientation (StatsBomb normalises the acting team to +x; no half-time flip, confirmed S31). zone_id = band*5 + lane (0-29). Consumed by the xT deriver and all occupancy/battle layers. Boundaries are tunable: band edges could align to the 18-yard line instead of equal sixths (banked).

bands._comment: x edges, low x = own defensive third, high x = opponent box. 6 equal sixths.

lanes._comment: y edges (4 internal cut points -> 5 lanes). Wing bounds reuse the S31 width-metric channels (y<=18 / y>=62) for consistency. LHS/RHS = half-spaces, C = central spine.
